mentions.name: AdaShape
mentions.description: A desktop 3D modeler for creating 3D printable shapes with a non-complicated workflow. The alpha 0.2.0 release adds many new modeling tools, including a lofting tool that lets users combine multiple drawings in an intuitive way to define complex 3D surfaces. Development also includes a growing manual, with changelogs written in product voice so the copy can be recycled verbatim into the documentation.
mentions.problem: Existing 3D modeling tools are complicated for creating 3D-printable shapes.
mentions.source_excerpt:
AdaShape, a non-complicated 3D modeler for 3D printable shapes (desktop).

I just released a new version with lots of new modeling tools:
https://adashape.com/blog/alpha-0-2-0/
mentions.author: fsloth
